name: Prime Strategy Co., Ltd.
summary: Prime Strategy Co., Ltd. provides cloud-based integration solutions for the Japanese market. Its services include KUSANAGI Managed Services for website system management across applications, middleware and servers, CMS platform integration, the WEXAL Mobile Display Acceleration Service for site performance, and Hyper Automation solutions. Dating from 2002 with its base in Tokyo, it is a subsidiary of FinTech Global Incorporated.
